title: sphenopholis glabra
intro: Sphenopholis glabra, commonly known as Smooth Wood Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Sphenopholis glabra include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
